extraction.Name: Edith Craven Knight
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee and accepted it under protest, because she was told that if she did not accept it and keep the taxes paid up that the land would be sold to satisfy them
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not raise the money to keep the taxes paid up
extraction.Occupation/Income: compelled to work for a living
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in just fair health for her age; has four minor children dependent upon her for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or county since her patent was issued; document sworn in State of Arizona, County of Yavapai, 1929 | TASK 3 SUBSTANTIVE CORRECTION 2026-04-29: BLM accession 625367 confirms Pine Ridge tribal affiliation despite off-reservation residence (Camp Wood, Arizona). Pine Ridge allottee residing in Arizona when affidavit given.
